$comment: Suggested MCP servers for CloudFuze Studio Migrate. These are OPTIONAL and commented via _enabled flags — enable only what your workflow needs and provide credentials via environment variables, never inline. The repo evidences a need for: GitHub (PRs/issues), MongoDB (the csge database the app persists to), and filesystem access to the docs/ knowledge base. Web browsing during development is handled by gstack's /browse, so no browser MCP is configured here.

github._why: Open/track PRs and issues for this repo. gstack /ship opens PRs; this MCP lets Claude read issue/PR context directly.

mongodb._why: Inspect the csge database (migrationRuns, migrationResults, stagedAgents, agentIRCache) while debugging a migration. Point at the CS_GE-owned instance on 27019. Use a READ-ONLY user in shared environments.

filesystem._why: Give Claude scoped read access to the docs/ knowledge base (specs, feasibility studies, edition/visibility findings) without scanning the whole tree.
